name: Kaisei (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kaisei town emblem in red: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character like a cross within a square.
history: Municipal flag of Kaisei, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 1956.

features.role: Kaisei town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character like a cross within a square
